collection.description: A child recovers unexpectedly after several villagers tried different remedies.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A child recovers unexpectedly after several villagers tried different remedies.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: A hopeful villager credits the child's will to survive.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: A gardener credits clean water and nourishment.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: A caregiver gives thanks to the gods without claiming certainty.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: A healer notes that the recovery does not establish which treatment worked.

r1.name: Resolution 1
r1.text: The villager discovers a plausible ordinary cause but may still value the experience for personal reasons.

r3.text: Another villager interprets the same evidence differently. Their exchange can deepen respect, cause a mild argument, or inspire a shared project.
